title: UCI 360 Air Quality (gas multisensor device, one road-level site in an Italian city, 2004-2005)
summary: Hourly averaged readings from a road-level air-quality chemical multisensor device in a polluted area of an Italian city (city not named in the metadata), with co-located certified reference-analyzer concentrations for CO, NMHC, benzene, NOx and NO2, plus five metal-oxide sensor responses, temperature, relative humidity and absolute humidity. Declared as 9,358 instances covering March 2004 to February 2005 at one location. It has no traffic, clinic or district fields, and it is a single-site research dataset, not a monitoring network.

documentation_excerpts: Missing values are tagged with -200 value.
Data were recorded from March 2004 to February 2005 (one year) representing the longest freely available recordings of on field deployed air quality chemical sensor devices responses.
This dataset can be used exclusively for research purposes. Commercial purposes are fully excluded.
The device was located on the field in a significantly polluted area, at road level, within an Italian city.
quality_notes: Declared 'has_missing_values: no' and every variable 'missing_values: no', but the notes say missing values are coded -200. The sample confirms -200 in CO(GT) (469 rows, about 18.5% missing in sample), NMHC(GT) (1,623, about 64%), NOx(GT) and NO2(GT) (about 18%), and about 3% in the sensor and T/RH/AH columns. Treat -200 as missing, not as a value.

C6H6(GT) shows no sentinel count in the sample, yet it has min -200.0 and 79 negative values. This suggests the -200 code is also used there, so the column is undercounted if only the sentinel is checked.

Date format conflict: variable_info says DD/MM/YYYY, but the sample's first dates (3/10/2004, 3/11/2004, 3/12/2004) parse as month/day/year and run to 2004-06-24 across 107 days. Confirm the format before parsing. Time is documented as HH.MM.SS, but the sample shows HH:00:00 values.

Metadata conflict on licence: the page text says CC BY 4.0, while the notes say research use only and commercial use fully excluded. Do not treat the data as open for commercial use until the owner confirms the licence.

Sensor columns (PT08.*) are uncalibrated sensor responses with documented cross-sensitivity and drift. The reference columns (CO(GT), NMHC(GT), C6H6(GT), NOx(GT), NO2(GT)) are the ground truth used for N1.

Only one road-level site over one year. The data does not cover the production window (2024-2025) and has no traffic counts (N2 not met). It has temperature and humidity (N3, prototype window only). It has no clinic data (N4, N5), and no national PM2.5 mortality data (N6).
The sample covered only the first 200,000 bytes (2,537 rows). The sample profile is not a full-file profile. Ranges and shares apply to the sample only.
The UCI dataset page does not state the city, the station's coordinates or the owner of the reference analyzer.
